about_the_game:
Become a Barrister in Hong Kong

A short visual novel set in Hong Kong where you play as Barbara, a newly minted barrister. This game is quite short, you can probably play through it in about two hours.

Features

  • Two cases

  • Three levels of court appearances

  • Two levels adventure game style investigating

  • Fully voice acted

  • Nice music

Characters

Barbara - The main character, the person you play as. Barbara has just been ceritified as a barrister and is about to do her first case.

Sundeep - Your boss. Sundeep is a renowned barrister who guides you through your court cases and investigations. Sometimes he gets distracted, but that just means you have more responsibility.

Korshal - Your client. Sundeep told you he was involved in a traffic dispute, but it turns out he is actually accused of committing a murder.

Jared - Someone who witnessed your client committing the murder.

Nelson - The prosecuting barrister. Nelson is trying to get your client charged with murder.

Judge Karen - The judge who presides over both court cases.

Audrey - The victim.

content_descriptors.notes:
- You play as a barrister defending clients who are accused of murder.
- There is mention of illegal drugs in one of the cases
- One character in the game smokes a cigarette
- There is a portion of the game where characters go out for alcoholic drinks.
